paite: Na unau bawngtal hiam, abelam hiam mang na muhleh na daihsan ding ahi kei. Na unau inn ah na pi ngeingei ding ahi.
english: You shall not see your brother’s ox or his sheep go astray and hide yourself from them. You shall surely bring them again to your brother.

paite: Na unau inn kiangnai a om ahih louh a, aneimi na theih louh uh ahihleh, na inn ah na pitou dia, na kiang ah a-om nilouh dia, na unau in azon hunhun in na pe nawn ding ahi.
english: If your brother isn’t near to you, or if you don’t know him, then you shall bring it home to your house, and it shall be with you until your brother comes looking for it, and you shall restore it to him.

paite: Huchi mah bang in asabiltung leng na hih ding ahi. Huai mah bang in apuansilh leng na hih ding ahi. Huchi mah bang in na unau thil mansak na muh peuhmah na hih ding ahi, na daihsan mawkmawk ding ahi kei.
english: So you shall do with his donkey. So you shall do with his garment. So you shall do with every lost thing of your brother’s, which he has lost and you have found. You may not hide yourself.

paite: Na unau sabiltung hiam, bawngtal hiam, lampi a puk na muhleh na daihsan maimah ding ahi kei. Na photpih ngeingei ding ahi.
english: You shall not see your brother’s donkey or his ox fallen down by the way, and hide yourself from them. You shall surely help him to lift them up again.

paite: Numei in pasal van asilh ding ahi kei. Pasal in numei van asilh ding ahi kei. Kuapeuh huchibang hihmi TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in kihhuai ahi.
english: A woman shall not wear men’s clothing, neither shall a man put on women’s clothing; for whoever does these things is an abomination to Yahweh your God.

paite: Lampi a vasabu, sing ah hiam, lei ah hiam, anou hiam, atui hiam om, anou hiam atui hiam, api in a-opkhum lai na muhleh api toh anou na lakkhawm ding ahi kei.
english: If you come across a bird’s nest on the way, in any tree or on the ground, with young ones or eggs, and the hen sitting on the young, or on the eggs, you shall not take the hen with the young.

paite: Api na khah ngeingei ding ahi. Anou bel na la thei ding ahi. Huchi in nang a ding in ahoih dia, na damsung na sawtsak ding hi.
english: You shall surely let the hen go, but the young you may take for yourself, that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days.

paite: Inn thak na lam chiang in atung a pan mi kia a, asisan moh na khuklouhna ding in atung na um ding ahi.
english: When you build a new house, then you shall make a railing around your roof, so that you don’t bring blood on your house if anyone falls from there.

paite: Na grephuan ah thil chi nih na ching ding ahi kei. Huchi lou in zaw na chi tuh gah leh na grephuan a gah teng siang lou ahi ding uhi.
english: You shall not sow your vineyard with two kinds of seed, lest all the fruit be defiled, the seed which you have sown, and the increase of the vineyard.

paite: Bawngtal leh sabiltung lei na kaikhawmsak ding ahi kei.
english: You shall not plow with an ox and a donkey together.

paite: Samul leh pat kigankhawm puan na silh ding ahi kei.
english: You shall not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together.

paite: Na kituamna puan uh agei li ah mong khih na bawl ding uh ahi.
english: You shall make yourselves fringes on the four corners of your cloak with which you cover yourself.

paite: Pasal khatpeuh in zi aneih a, akithuahpih a, amuhdah nawn thepthup a,
heading: Numei Pasal Kal Sianthouna Toh Kisai
english: If any man takes a wife, and goes in to her, hates her,

paite: hiai numei ka kitenpih a, ka kithuahpih a, nungak siangthou ahihna ka mu kei, chi a zahlaktak a bawl a, amin ahihsiatleh,
english: accuses her of shameful things, gives her a bad name, and says, “I took this woman, and when I came near to her, I didn’t find in her the tokens of virginity;”

paite: nungak nu leh pa'n kulh kongpi ah huai kho upate kiang ah nungak siangthou ahih kichetnate ahon tawi ding uhi.
english: then the young lady’s father and mother shall take and bring the tokens of the young lady’s virginity to the elders of the city in the gate.

paite: Nungak pa'n upate kiang ah, "Hiai mipa ka tanu ka neisak a, aho nawn thepthup hi.
english: The young lady’s father shall tell the elders, “I gave my daughter to this man as his wife, and he hates her.

paite: Ngai un, na tanu nungak siangthou ahihna ka mu kei, chi in zahlaktak in abawl a, himahleh hiaite ka tanu nungak siangthou ahihna ahi,” achi ding hi. Huchi in huai kho upate ma ah tua puan aphah ding hi.
english: Behold, he has accused her of shameful things, saying, ‘I didn’t find in your daughter the tokens of virginity;’ and yet these are the tokens of my daughter’s virginity.” They shall spread the cloth before the elders of the city.

paite: Huai kho upate'n huai mipa paipih in agawt ding ua;
english: The elders of that city shall take the man and chastise him.

paite: Israel nungak siangthou asukminsiat ziak in dangka shekel zakhat aliausak ding ua, nungak pa ape ding uhi; amah zi ahi dia, adamsung in akhen thei kei ding.
english: They shall fine him one hundred shekels of silver, and give them to the father of the young lady, because he has given a bad name to a virgin of Israel. She shall be his wife. He may not put her away all his days.

paite: Himahleh huai mipa thu ana dik a, nungak siangthou ahih kichetnate muh ahihkeileh;
english: But if this thing is true, that the tokens of virginity were not found in the young lady,

paite: nungak pen apa'n kongpi ah apikhe dia, atenna khua a mite'n amah suang in adenglum ding uh; apa inn a kizuak a Israelte lak a thil gilou haihuai mahmah ahih ziak in. Huchibang in na lak ua kipan, huai thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uhi.
english: then they shall bring out the young lady to the door of her father’s house, and the men of her city shall stone her to death with stones, because she has done folly in Israel, to play the prostitute in her father’s house. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

paite: Pasal khat in pasal nei numei akithuahpih lai muh ahihleh akithuahpih pasal leh numei anih ua asih ding uh ahi. Huchibang in Israel a pan huai thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uhi.
english: If a man is found lying with a woman married to a husband, then they shall both die, the man who lay with the woman and the woman. So you shall remove the evil from Israel.

paite: Nungak siangthou, mi zikham, pasal khat in khopi a amuh a, akithuahpihleh;
english: If there is a young lady who is a virgin pledged to be married to a husband, and a man finds her in the city, and lies with her,

paite: anih un khokulh kongpi ah na pikhe ding ua, suang in na denglum ding uh; numei pen khua a-om ngal a, akikou louh ziak in. Pasal pen a-invengte zi ahihminsiat ziak in. Huchibang in na lak ua kipan huai thil hoih lou na hihmang ding uh ahi.
english: then you shall bring them both out to the gate of that city, and you shall stone them to death with stones; the lady, because she didn’t cry, being in the city; and the man, because he has humbled his neighbor’s wife. So you shall remove the evil from among you.

paite: Himahleh min gamlak a midang in zi dia akhamsa nungak amuh a, apawngsualleh hiai thilhih pasal kia sihsak ding ahi.
english: But if the man finds the lady who is pledged to be married in the field, and the man forces her and lies with her, then only the man who lay with her shall die;

paite: Nungak pen bangmah loh louh ding ahi. Nungak in sihna khop khelhna bangmah hih lou ahi. Hiai bang mi ahihleh min a-invengte sual a, that toh kibang ahi.
english: but to the lady you shall do nothing. There is in the lady no sin worthy of death; for as when a man rises against his neighbor and kills him, even so is this matter;

paite: Hiai bang thu ahihleh gamlak a va tuak kha a, mi zikham nungak kikou a, panpih ding mi om lou ahih ziak ahi.
english: for he found her in the field, the pledged to be married lady cried, and there was no one to save her.

paite: Mi'n nungak siangthou kuamah kham louh amuh a, amat a, akithuahpih amuh uleh;
english: If a man finds a lady who is a virgin, who is not pledged to be married, grabs her and lies with her, and they are found,

paite: akithuahpih pasal in nungak pa dangka shekel sawmnga ape ding ahi. Zi in anei ding ahi; ahihminsiat tak ziak in. Huchi in adamsung in akhen thei kei ding hi.
english: then the man who lay with her shall give to the lady’s father fifty shekels of silver. She shall be his wife, because he has humbled her. He may not put her away all his days.

paite: Pasal in apa zi akitenpih ding ahi kei. Apa lupna abuahsak ding ahi kei.
english: A man shall not take his father’s wife, and shall not uncover his father’s skirt.
